Subject: QM Dashboard Implementation | Progress Update 

Dear Team,

I'd like to provide a brief update on the current status of the QM Dashboard project and next steps moving forward: 

Since our last call, we have finalized the data extraction scripts to pull relevant data from the various hospital systems in near real-time. These are successfully loading data into our sandbox environment. So far, we estimate our dashboard will support pulling over 32 million data points on a regular cadence to power its KPIs, up from an initial projection of 28 million. Our ETL pipeline will also support an additional 6 data fields not included in the first phase of dashboard reporting (which were not yet determined when planning commenced) to ensure maximum flexibility and extensibility going forward.

Over the next three weeks, I will lead efforts to develop and deploy all remaining data processing components to our staging environment - which includes building machine learning models on this raw data stream for key KPI predictive
